cover.callout: Each booth is shown five ways — an exterior render, a dimensioned exterior, a front elevation with the door open, a rear view of the ventilation package, and a top-down floor plan.

sections.lead: MDL 9696 E — a 9' × 9' Enhanced double-wall enclosure standing 8' 7 13/16" overall. The five views that follow show it from every side, with the door open to the interior acoustic treatment.

Front elevation with the door open — ramp threshold, window in the door, and the interior acoustic treatment.
Rear three-quarter view — exterior ventilation ducting.
Top-down plan — 9' × 9' footprint, with the door swing and ramp projecting 3' 9 5/8" beyond the front wall.

sections.lead: MDL 7296 E — an 8' 2" × 7' Enhanced double-wall enclosure standing 9' 9/16" overall. The same five views, rendered from the same model.

closing.heading: Questions about this configuration
closing.body: Every WhisperRoom enclosure is built from interchangeable wall components — the door, window, and ventilation can move to a different wall to suit your space.
